ModMetaData.name: GateRim SG-1
ModMetaData.author: Diablood
ModMetaData.description:
GateRim SG-1 brings the Stargate SG-1 universe to RimWorld.
Current development scope: - Inheritable Jaffa lineage genes - Prim'ta Hediff prototype for an implanted immature symbiote - Medical Jaffa Prim'ta implantation prototype - Physical Prim'ta larva resource consumed by implantation surgery - Constructible Prim'ta incubation basin and larva-production bill - Raw-meat nutrient requirement for Prim'ta larva incubation - Vanilla preservation prototype for physical Prim'ta larvae - Dedicated non-food biological storage category for Prim'ta larvae - Prim'ta larva temperature-tuning prototype with heat acceleration - Prim'ta implantation biological-age eligibility prototype - Progressive Jaffa puberty dependency prototype without Prim'ta - Lightweight Jaffa Prim'ta cultural-thought prototype - Temporary tretonin substitution prototype for Jaffa without Prim'ta - Drug-lab tretonin acquisition prototype using one Prim'ta larva - Formal Jaffa Prim'ta ceremony prototype at the Goa'uld ritual basin - Tok'ra foundation prototype with voluntary adult-symbiote implantation - Developer-spawnable player-controlled Tok'ra voluntary-host pawn prototype - Tok'ra pawn-group foundation prototype for developer tests - Low-frequency natural Tok'ra peaceful visitor incident prototype - RimWorld-oriented Tok'ra biological healing with curable-condition filtering and progressive wound regeneration - Explicit voluntary Tok'ra therapeutic implantation prototype with consent confirmation - Time-limited escorted Tok'ra therapeutic-opportunity incident with explicit refusal and coordinated departure - Persistent Tok'ra trust tiers modulating therapeutic-offer duration, escort size and tretonin support gifts - Trust-gated independent Tok'ra medical-support delivery incident - Trust-weighted storyteller chances for Tok'ra therapeutic offers and medical-support deliveries - Persistent wary Tok'ra diplomatic cooldown after refused or expired therapeutic offers - Trusted Tok'ra medical-support deliveries include one advanced ultratech medicine unit - Goa'uld host xenotype prototype - Free Goa'uld symbiote pawn prototype - Recent Goa'uld implantation Hediff prototype - French translations for stabilized content - Player wiki maintained in parallel - Centralized colored C# logging with optional advanced-debug visibility - Windows build wrapper - Persistent Goa'uld symbiote identity data - Interactive forced Goa'uld implantation prototype - Automatic conversion into an active Goa'uld host state - Manual emergency extraction during recent implantation - Medical emergency Goa'uld extraction surgery - Autonomous free-symbiote pursuit and contact implantation - Controlled ritual Goa'uld implantation prototype - Explicit map target selection for ritual implantation - Timed core ritual ceremony with cancellation and save persistence - Core Goa'uld ritual basin environmental requirement - Developer-spawnable Goa'uld queen biological-foundation prototype - Developer-only queen-origin immature-symbiote extraction prototype - Queen-origin assisted Prim'ta maturation at the incubation basin - Powered Prim'ta preservation-basin storage prototype - Persistent Prim'ta deep-freezing penalties outside active preservation basins - Visible hostile Goa'uld System Lord world-faction baseline with limited settlements - Remove invalid Goa'uld FactionDef world-icon fields for RimWorld 1.6 - Expose the Goa'uld faction in RimWorld 1.6 world creation and normalize French player-facing vocabulary - Capitalize the French Goa'uld faction name and restore the SGC expedition faction icon - Visible neutral Free Jaffa world-faction baseline with limited settlements - Free Jaffa warrior and guard profiles with Prim'ta, Ma'Tok and modular armor - Automatic forehead marks restricted to Goa'uld-domain Jaffa; Free Jaffa remain unmarked - Faction-level Jaffa xenotype summaries aligned with current generated populations - Configurable multi-faction limits and provisional generated leaders for Goa'uld and Free Jaffa factions - Persistent Goa'uld host-caste baseline with minority settlement hosts and real System Lord leaders - Stabilized Goa'uld settlement caste mix and broad temporary Tau'ri vanilla-backstory filter - Provisional vanilla attire and initial chronic-ailment healing for generated Goa'uld hosts - Fix provisional Goa'uld shirt reference to vanilla Apparel_CollarShirt - Cultural backstory baseline for Tau'ri, Jaffa, Goa'uld hosts and generated Tok'ra agents - Define standard male and female body types for every dedicated adulthood backstory - Contextual social baseline with Free Jaffa, Tok'ra, Goa'uld-host and System Lord proximity reactions - Goa'uld-aligned Jaffa pawn kinds with Combat and Settlement profiles - Automatic Prim'ta provisioning for generated Goa'uld-aligned Jaffa servants - Craftable Ma'Tok staff weapon prototype with dedicated temporary graphics - Ma'Tok plasma-impact prototype with reduced structural damage against non-organic targets and buildings - Zat'nik'tel first-shot incapacitation prototype with weak EMP disruption against mechanical targets - SG-team olive-drab field-uniform prototype - Separate SG tactical-boots prototype with lightweight foot protection - Separate SG tactical-gloves prototype with lightweight hand protection - Separate SG tactical-vest prototype with modest torso and shoulder protection - Black and desert SG-team field-uniform visual variants - First playable stranded SG-team starter scenario without a functional Stargate - Scenario refinement: dedicated SGC expedition faction, four candidates, violence-capable starters and translated launch narrative - Optional SG-team open-face field-helmet prototype supplied by the stranded-team scenario - Vanilla weapon-tag Ma'Tok loadout for generated Goa'uld-aligned Jaffa servants - Modular Jaffa armor prototypes with localized hand, finger, foot and toe protection - Persistent retractable Jaffa helmet modes with automatic drafted deployment - Deterministic modular armor loadouts for generated Goa'uld-aligned Jaffa servants - Low-frequency natural Goa'uld Jaffa direct-assault raid incident - Developer-only controlled Goa'uld Jaffa raid incident with zero storyteller chance - Explicit vanilla ImmediateAttack strategy for controlled Goa'uld Jaffa raid tests - Developer-only controlled Goa'uld Jaffa abduction raid with cover-and-extract doctrine - Developer-only controlled Goa'uld Jaffa destruction raid with post-assault recovery phase - Save-persistent intrinsic Jaffa forehead-mark data independent from genes, xenotypes and apparel - Automatic migration from obsolete technical forehead-mark genes - Developer map tools to assign or remove black, silver and gold forehead marks on any pawn - Data-driven Goa'uld System Lord domain identity foundation with rank-specific intrinsic-mark slots - Player-facing GateRim SG-1 setting for optional advanced diagnostic information - Goa'uld world presence and rare natural direct-assault raids enabled; advanced natural doctrines remain planned - Global object-category audit planned before final stabilization - Optional Ideology integration, expanded ceremony requirements and host transfer planned later
Biotech is required for xenotype support.
This is an early development version.
